rows.title_full: AN ACT REDUCING THE RETIREMENT AGE OF GOVERNMENT EMPLOYEES, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE THE REVISED GOVERNMENT SERVICE INSURANCE ACT, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: REDUCES the optional retirement for government employees from fifteen (15) years to at least TWELVE (12) YEARS of service, provided that the employee is at least FIFTY-FIVE years of age; the compulsory retirement age to SIXTY (60) years with at least TWELVE (12) years of service.

rows.abstract: "Aquatic and Marine Resources Development Act of the Philippines". Esablishes an AQUATIC AND MARINE RESOURCES COMMISSION to be tasked mainly with the formulation of policies and directions and a Bureau under it to serve as and administrative arm toimplement such policies an directions.

rows.abstract: "Government Assistance to Youth for Agricultural Productivity Act". Declares it a State policy to provide assistance to youth who are engaged in agriculture by providing for skills in agricultural management and technology transfer so that productivity will be maximized and youth can earn a livelihood.

rows.author: C103
rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A PHILIPPINE AGRICULTURAL MODERNIZATION PROGRAM, AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract: "Philippine Agricultural Modernization Program (PAMP) Act". States the following as the objectives of the Program: (1) to improve the agricultural infrastructures and facilities; (2) to initiate, consolidate and institute proper coordination and implementation of all irrigation, agricultural mechanization and other agricultural engineering programs and projects; (3) to promote and accelerate rural and agri-industrial ization; (4) to hasten the generation, development extension of appropriate technologies for the countrysides, etc.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on AGRICULTURE AND FOOD since 1998-08-24

rows.abstract: Punishes any movie and television personality or producer or any person found violating this Act by a fine of not less than One Hundred Thousand Pesos (P100,000.00) nor more than Two Hundred Thousand Pesos (P200,000.00), or by an imprisonment of notless than six (6) months nor more than one (1) year or both fine and iumprisonment at the discretion of the court.
